name: Exp_ColorSchaffDeMarkerTrendCycle
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorSchaffDeMarkerTrendCycle custom indicator, which combines fast and slow DeMarker oscillators with a cyclical trend component. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from a downtrend color zone to an uptrend zone, and sell positions on the reverse transition, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorSchaffDeMarkerTrendCycle自定义指标进行交易，该指标结合了快慢DeMarker振荡器和周期性趋势分量。当指标从下跌趋势颜色区域转换到上涨趋势区域时开多仓，反向转换时开空仓，并带有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Schaff趋势周期指标，该指标融合了快速DeMarker(周期23)和慢速DeMarker(周期50)的双重振荡器计算，并叠加周期为10的趋势循环分量来识别趋势方向。入场条件为：当指标颜色缓冲区值大于5（上升趋势确认）且前一值小于6（刚从非上升趋势转换）时开多仓；当颜色缓冲区值小于2（下降趋势确认）且前一值大于1（刚从非下降趋势转换）时开空仓。出场条件依赖固定的止损(1000点)和止盈(2000点)设置，同时当反向信号出现时会平掉对应仓位（如上升趋势信号时平空头）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1，并支持五种资金管理模式（自由保证金、余额、损失后自由保证金、损失后余额、固定手数）。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的标准化函数实现买卖仓位开平操作，包含滑点偏差控制。策略默认在H4周期运行，使用SignalBar=1即前一根已收盘K线的信号来避免重绘。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Schaff Trend Cycle indicator, which integrates dual DeMarker oscillators (fast period 23 and slow period 50) with a cyclical trend component (period 10) to identify trend direction. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the indicator color buffer value is above 5 (uptrend confirmed) and the previous value is below 6 (just transitioned from non-uptrend); a sell position opens when the color buffer value is below 2 (downtrend confirmed) and the previous value is above 1 (just transitioned from non-downtrend). Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss (1000 points) and take-profit (2000 points) settings, while opposing signals also trigger closing of corresponding positions (e.g., uptrend signal closes sell positions). Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter with a default of 0.1, supporting five money management modes: free margin, balance, loss-based free margin, loss-based balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is implemented through standardized functions in the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for opening and closing buy/sell positions, with slippage deviation control. The strategy defaults to H4 timeframe and uses SignalBar=1, meaning it evaluates the previously closed bar's signal to avoid repainting issues.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例或固定手数
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter controlling position size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式（自由保证金/余额/损失后自由保证金/损失后余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode (fixed lot or margin ratio)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号K线索引（0=当前Bar，1=前一根已收盘Bar）

pros: 使用双DeMarker振荡器结合周期趋势分量，信号经过平滑处理减少了假信号
支持五种资金管理模式，灵活适应不同风险偏好的交易者
使用SignalBar=1基于已收盘K线信号交易，避免指标重绘导致的虚假入场
买卖开关可独立控制，允许只做单边交易或仅用信号平仓
有新Bar检测机制(IsNewBar)，避免同一根K线内重复开仓
pros_en: Dual DeMarker oscillators combined with cyclical trend component provide smoothed signals that reduce false entries
Five money management modes offer flexibility for traders with different risk preferences
Using SignalBar=1 based on closed bar signals avoids repainting and prevents false entries from unrealized values
Independent buy/sell open/close switches allow one-directional trading or signal-only closing strategies
New bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) prevents redundant position openings within the same bar
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值过大，在许多品种上可能不合适，缺乏动态止损机制
没有点差过滤，虽然不是剥头皮策略但在H4周期某些高点差品种仍可能受影响
指标依赖iCustom调用外部自定义指标，部署时需要确保指标文件存在，增加了维护复杂度
策略缺乏市场波动率适应性，固定参数在不同市场环境下可能表现差异很大
没有最大持仓数限制和回撤控制，在连续信号时可能过度开仓
cons_en: Default SL=1000 and TP=2000 points are excessively large for many instruments, and there is no dynamic stop-loss mechanism
No spread filter is implemented, which could impact performance on high-spread instruments even on H4 timeframe
The EA relies on iCustom to call an external custom indicator, requiring the indicator file to be present at deployment, increasing maintenance complexity
The strategy lacks market volatility adaptability, with fixed parameters likely performing very differently across varying market conditions
No maximum position limit or drawdown control, which could lead to over-exposure on consecutive signals
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈机制，替代固定点数值以适应不同市场波动率
添加最大同时持仓数限制和账户回撤保护，防止极端行情下过度暴露风险
增加点差和波动率过滤条件，避免在高点差或低流动性时段入场
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to replace fixed point values, adapting to different market volatility regimes
Implement maximum concurrent position limits and account drawdown protection to prevent over-exposure in extreme market conditions
Add spread and volatility filters to avoid entering trades during high-spread or low-liquidity periods

risk_points: 固定止损止盈值过大，在某些品种上可能无法有效限制风险
缺少最大持仓限制和回撤保护机制，连续信号可能导致过度持仓
依赖外部自定义指标文件，若缺失则EA无法初始化
risk_points_en: Fixed stop-loss and take-profit values are very large and may not effectively limit risk on all instruments
No maximum position limit or drawdown protection, consecutive signals could lead to over-exposure
Dependency on external custom indicator file; if missing, the EA fails to initialize
